name: @interego/workspace-client
description: Transport-agnostic client for the shared-workspace vertical: hardened Turtle/TriG readers, the member-document naming scheme, the seat fold, the supersession chain walk and the compare-and-swap append. The ONE copy of this logic — the published artifact's script is generated from it and gated against drift, and the desktop shell imports it directly.
author: Mark Spivey
